title: Asking, Telling and Demanding
goal: Ask, tell or forbid others to do things with verbs of influence and the subjunctive.

sections.title: Unit 4: Influence, Will & Value Judgments
body: At B2 you do more than state facts: you tell people what to do, say what is fair or strange, and react to what others do. This unit is about the subjunctive in those situations.

You will practise verbs of influence, value judgments, reactions, the choice between an infinitive and que + subjunctive, and polite recommendations. The unit ends with a short text about the Mexican writer Carlos Fuentes and his novel La muerte de Artemio Cruz.

items: I can ask, tell or forbid others to do things with exigir que, ordenar que, prohibir que and permitir que.
I can match the present or the imperfect subjunctive to the tense of the main verb.
I can use the new words for demands and rules.
